# Where this product puts its files, and what `flz reset` does with each
# subtree. One row per subtree, `<name>|<reset mode>`, read by both runtimes:
# `Flezha.Layout.Table` declares the controller's side and
# `crates/cli/src/reset/plan.rs`'s `ROOTS` the shell's, and a test on each side holds
# its table equal to this file. Before, the two spelled the list separately and
# a user could not tell which one was right.
#
# `default` is cleared on every reset, `flag` only when the user asks for
# it by name, and `never` is not reset's to clear. A user's tokens, the
# audit trail and installed plugins are data someone keeps on purpose, so each
# is a flag of its own rather than part of every reset. The log directory is
# `never`: it is named relative to wherever the controller runs, and reset
# cannot tell which directory that was. Reset reports every row, `never` rows
# as kept.
#
# Order is the order reset reports.
state|default
process_hub|default
certs|flag
dlq|flag
schedules|flag
auth|flag
audit|flag
relay_history|default
plugins|flag
sockets|flag
logs|never
